instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. In a dry grassy field under a clear blue sky, the woman in the shearling-lined denim jacket (R1) on the left and the man in the denim jacket (R2) on the right stand closely embraced in a warm hug. She wraps her arms around his shoulders while he holds her waist, both smiling happily. Bright natural sunlight illuminates the couple, casting soft shadows on the dry grass and creating a warm, affectionate mood.
elements: R1 wraps her arms around R2's shoulders
R1 and R2 stand closely embraced with distinct shoulder-versus-waist roles
R1 and R2 are smiling happily during the embrace
The scene is in a dry grassy field under a clear blue sky
